title: Reception & Customer Access
objective: Build a pain-engineered Reception & Customer Access workforce that preserves one customer journey across inbound contact, response, qualification, routing, booking, after-hours/urgent continuity, handoffs and missed-revenue recovery. Channels are tools; agent identities are defined by distinct pain/outcome ownership.

subgoals.completion_basis: acceptance gates and complete outcome, not planned pass count
subgoals.reuse_instruction: Deep-scan and compare the referenced Library donor code before implementation. Converge/port/adapt verified behavior; do not rebuild an existing system from scratch unless donor incompatibility or absence is proven and recorded.

recommendations: Reuse channels as tools/capabilities rather than creating one agent identity per channel.
Create a new agent only for a distinct pain/outcome boundary.
